dashboard.label: TA-baseline Overview
dashboard.description: Collects a host security baseline from the kernel/filesystem: UEFI SecureBoot state, kernel lockdown mode, SSH root-login and password-auth settings (sshd_config, including

search.query: | mstats avg("baseline.weak_ssh") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("baseline.auditd_active") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
| mstats avg("baseline.lockdown") as value where index=metrics span=5m | fields - _time | tail 1
index=main sourcetype="baseline:status" | dedup host | table host auditd_active lockdown weak_ssh password_auth permit_root_login secure_boot
